title: SFX -- world rest (goodnight waltz, homesick)
_note: Alternative rest jingle: a two-bar 3/4 lullaby that starts in A minor (the homesick catch) and settles into C major on the last note -- the Vesper settle stretched over a waltz. Bell + harp + pad + bass. ~3.9 s incl. ring-out. Render --tail 0.6 to .wav, then encode to .mp3 untrimmed (it plays over silence).
